faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Helpful details before visiting Fashion Nails Morley Galleria.
faq.q1: What is the difference between BIAB, Gel X, and Acrylic?
faq.a1: BIAB is a flexible builder gel applied over natural nails to add strength. Gel X uses full-cover soft gel tips for a lightweight extension. Acrylic is a traditional powder enhancement offering the highest durability and structure.
faq.q2: How do I claim the 10% discount?
faq.a2: Simply present your Student ID, Seniors Card, or Morley Galleria Staff badge at checkout when paying in-salon.
faq.a3: Yes! Walk-ins are always welcome. However, booking online in advance guarantees you won't have to wait during peak shopping hours.
faq.a4: Yes, Gift Vouchers are readily available at the counter in any denomination, making the perfect gift for loved ones.

chapter1.headline: A sanctuary of quiet luxury inside buzzing Morley Galleria.
chapter1.lead: Step through our doors and let the commotion of the shopping centre fade away. Gentle ambient warm lighting, relaxing scents, and plush ergonomic spa thrones create an intimate haven dedicated entirely to your self-care.

chapter2.headline: Sterile pouches unsealed before your eyes. Zero hygiene compromise.
chapter2.lead: Every cuticle nipper, steel pusher, and carbide drill bit undergoes hospital-grade 134°C pressurized steam autoclaving. Files, buffers, and pumices are strictly single-use. We protect your natural nail wellness like family.

chapter3.headline: Natural nail vitality first. Fortification without structural damage.
chapter3.lead: Specializing in Japanese Builder Gel (BIAB) that empowers weak nails to grow resiliently, ultra-lightweight Gel-X extensions, and bespoke hand-painted French, chrome glazing, and cat-eye ombre precision.

chapter4.headline: Proudly serving Morley, Dianella & the Greater Perth Community.
chapter4.lead: Complete pricing transparency with zero hidden fees. Honoring our community with 10% off for Seniors, Students, and Morley Galleria Staff, alongside beautifully presented Gift Vouchers.
